title: [FishLaws] Linter/Formatter — PEP8, mypy, import order, code style
description: ## [FishLaws] Linter/Formatter **Bot:** @fishing_laws_bot — Нормы вылова, лицензии, запреты нереста по регионам РФ. **Stack:** Python 3.12, aiogram 3.x, SQLAlchemy 2.x async, PostgreSQL **Scale:** с нуля **Your focus:** PEP8, mypy, import order, code style --- ## Code is included below — start immediately, no need to request it. ### bot/config.py ```python import os from dotenv import load_dotenv load_dotenv() BOT_TOKEN: str = os.environ["BOT_TOKEN"] DATABASE_URL: str = os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] ADMIN_ID: int = int(os.environ.get("ADMIN_ID", "")) LOG_LEVEL: str = os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO") ``` ### bot/handlers/start.py ```python from aiogram import Router from aiogram.filters import CommandStart from aiogram.types import Message router = Router() @router.message(CommandStart()) async def cmd_start(msg: Message): await msg.answer( f"👋 Привет, {msg.from_user.first_name}!\n\n" f"🎣 FishLaws\nНормы вылова, лицензии, запреты нереста.\n\n" "Бот в разработке. Скоро запустим!", parse_mode="HTML", ) ``` ### main.py ```python #!/usr/bin/env python3 """ FishLaws Bot — Нормы вылова, лицензии, запреты нереста. """ import asyncio import logging from aiogram import Bot, Dispatcher from aiogram.fsm.storage.memory import MemoryStorage from bot.config import BOT_TOKEN, LOG_LEVEL from bot.handlers import start logging.basicConfig(level=getattr(logging, LOG_LEVEL)) log = logging.getLogger(__name__) async def main(): bot = Bot(token=BOT_TOKEN) dp = Dispatcher(storage=MemoryStorage()) dp.include_router(start.router) log.info("FishLaws starting...") await dp.start_polling(bot) if __name__ == "__main__": asyncio.run(main()) ``` --- ## Your task Analyze the code above. Focus strictly on: **PEP8, mypy, import order, code style** Do 3 passes: - Pass 1: Find all issues related to your focus - Pass 2: Write fixes for every issue found - Pass 3: Verify fixes don't break anything else ## Acceptance Criteria - py_compile passes (no syntax errors) - No bare `except: pass` - parse_mode="HTML" on all message sends - No hardcoded secrets or tokens - IDOR protection: objects checked by user_id ## Deliverable — reply with ALL 5 sections: SECTION 1: ISSUES FOUND | # | File | Line | Issue | Severity | SECTION 2: FIXED FILES (only changed files — full code) ```filename.py [full updated code] ``` SECTION 3: GIT-DIFF ```diff [unified diff] ``` SECTION 4: TEST REPORT | # | Function | Tested | Bugs Found | Fixed | SECTION 5: RECOMMENDATIONS [What else should be improved]
